title: Proposal Management Senior Analyst
description:
**Skill required:** 
 Proposal Management \- Developing Proposals
   

  

**Designation:** 
 Proposal Management Senior Analyst
   

  

**Qualifications:** 
 Any Graduation
   

  

**Years of Experience:** 
 5 to 8 years
   

  

**About Accenture**
 Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
   

  

**What would you do?** 
 Proposal Management supports proposal development and coordination activities within Accenture s Sales Excellence Proposal Management capability. With relevant experience in proposal support, content coordination, and document management, the Senior Analyst independently handles core proposal tasks and works closely with Proposal Managers on larger or more complex bids. This role builds strong working knowledge of the RFx lifecycle and prepares the individual for broader proposal ownership over time. You are organized, detail\-focused, and confident handling day\-to\-day proposal coordination in a fast\-paced environment. You know how to keep tasks moving, work effectively with different contributors, and maintain quality under tight timelines. You are a dependable team member who can manage core support activities independently while continuing to build broader proposal management capability.
   

  

**What are we looking for?** 
 Core Requirements:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline
* Minimum of 3 years’ experience in proposal support, with a strong focus on business writing and proposal content management
* Practical experience in RFx processes and proposal management within an IT or professional services environment
* Strong command of the English language, both written and verbal
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook) for document preparation, data management, reporting and presentations
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage tight timelines and ensure high\-quality, compliant outputs
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and coordinate with cross\-functional stakeholders
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment
* Industry experience in IT, professional services, or a related field is preferred Preferred Qualifications:
* Minimum of 3 years’ experience in proposal coordination, including managing cross\-functional contributors, timelines, and submission compliance
* At least 3 years of writing experience supporting proposal development and bid responses, with strong attention to clarity, consistency, and messaging
* Experience in business, technical, or creative writing, with the ability to adapt content for different audiences and purposes
* Hands\-on experience in RFx processes and proposal management within an IT or professional services environment
* Working knowledge of collaboration platforms such as SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, or similar tools for document management and team coordination
* Good understanding and appreciation of AI\-enabled productivity and content support tools used in proposal development, with the ability to apply them to improve efficiency and quality
* Demonstrates openness to contributing to the company’s success, with a proactive and collaborative mindset
* Able to work effectively in a virtual or distributed team, collaborating smoothly with stakeholders across different locations and time zones Roles and Responsibilities:
* Roles \& Responsibilities: Proposal Coordination
* Assist in creating RFx outlines, document templates, and proposal folder structures
* Coordinate team meetings, manage calendar invites, and maintain action/decision logs
* Track proposal milestones and send timely reminders to contributors
* Format, assemble, and perform quality checks on proposal documents per brand guidelines
* Manage version control and maintain organised shared drive / SharePoint proposal repositories
* Support production activities: printing, binding, uploading, and submission logistics Content Support
* Source boilerplate and reusable content from Content Management repositories
* Apply basic editing and proofreading to ensure grammar, consistency, and formatting compliance
* Assist in preparing presentation decks for orals, site visits, and client workshops
* Populate standard proposal sections (company profile, credentials, team bios) using approved content Collaboration Tools \& Workspace Management
* Set up and maintain proposal workspaces on SharePoint, Teams, and collaboration portals
* Facilitate file sharing, access permissions, and version tracking across geographically dispersed teams
* Support virtual meeting logistics including recording, transcription, and distribution of notes Key Competencies:
* Attention to Detail
* Calendar \& Task Management
* MS Office Proficiency
* Written Communication
* Team Collaboration
* Process Adherence
* Learning Agility

title: Training Consultant
description:
****Career Area:****
 Product Support
   

  

****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
   

  

 Develops and delivers training programs for dealers and customer\-facing employees to enhance condition monitoring capabilities. Partners with business units and dealers to identify training needs, improve technical proficiency, and support the effective use of condition monitoring processes, tools, and technologies.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
**Training Development \& Delivery**
* Design, develop, and deliver training programs that align with organizational customer service and condition monitoring processes.
* Ensure training content, course materials, and delivery methods remain relevant, effective, and aligned with business objectives.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on the Five Elements of Condition Monitoring and the application of key tools, including Cat Inspect, Cat® Foresight, SOS Services, SIMSi, VisionLinkTM , SIS 2\.0 etc


**Training Effectiveness \& Continuous Improvement**
* Gather and analyze participant feedback to evaluate training effectiveness.
* Measure training ROI and implement improvements to maximize learning outcomes and business impact.
* Assess emerging training methodologies, technologies, and content delivery approaches to enhance future learning programs.


**Content Governance \& Compliance**
* Review, update, and maintain training materials to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with organizational policies and procedures.
* Ensure training resources reflect current processes, tools, and industry best practices.


**Business Partnership \& Consulting**
* Collaborate with business units, dealers, and other stakeholders to identify capability gaps and define training requirements.
* Provide guidance and recommendations on learning strategies that support business and customer success objectives.


**Technology \& Continuous Learning**
* Stay current with evolving technologies, digital tools, and industry trends, including Artificial Intelligence (AI).
* Promote a culture of continuous learning by sharing knowledge and helping others build awareness and proficiency in emerging technologies.


**Skill Descriptors
   

  

 Customer Focus:** 
 Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Communicates the importance of customer needs/expectations and commits to resolving them.
* Researches and verifies customer needs and expectations.
* Solicits customer satisfaction feedback and acts on improvement opportunities.


**Service Excellence:** 
 Knowledge of customer service concepts and techniques; ability to meet or exceed customer needs and expectations and provide excellent service in a direct or indirect manner.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Anticipates customers' needs and satisfies them proactively.
* Resolves complex customer complaints or problems.
* Teaches others how to deliver excellent customer service in a variety of settings.
* Applies the concept of 'Moments of Truth' to customer service.


**Consulting:** 
 Knowledge of techniques, roles, and responsibilities in providing technical or business guidance to clients, both internal and external; ability to apply consulting knowledge appropriately.
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Explains the requirements, deliverables, costs, and criticalities of the assignment.
* Participates in developing consulting opportunities or assignments.
* Uses formal and informal means to keep client informed on progress and issues.


**Decision Making and Critical Thinking:** 
 Knowledge of the decision\-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Differentiates assumptions, perspectives, and historical frameworks.
* Evaluates past decisions for insights to improve decision\-making process.
* Assesses and validates decision options and points and predicts their potential impact.
* Advises others in analyzing and synthesizing relevant data and assessing alternatives.


**Effective Communications:** 
 Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Reviews others' writing or presentations and provides feedback and coaching.
* Adapts documents and presentations for the intended audience.
* Demonstrates both empathy and assertiveness when communicating a need or defending a position.


**Problem Solving:** 
 Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
* Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.


**Relationship Management:** 
 Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers.
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Provides prompt and effective responses to client requests and interactions.
* Monitors client satisfaction levels on a regular basis.
* Alerts own team to problems in client satisfaction.


**Training Operations:** 
 Knowledge of training processes and procedures; ability to implement training related tasks and programs to ensure smooth daily and strategic training operations.
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Assesses customer feedback to better adjust to market demands.
* Implements day\-to\-day training activities within the organization.
* Follows relevant practices and procedures for the delivery of training services.

title: IFS Cloud Enablement Architect
description:
**About the Role** 




 Mediant Labs is seeking an experienced
 **ERP Enablement Architect** 
 to lead the learning and user enablement strategy for a global IFS Cloud ERP implementation.
 



 This is a strategic consulting role responsible for ensuring that end users are prepared to successfully adopt new business processes and system workflows.
 



 The successful candidate will possess a unique combination of ERP implementation experience, business process understanding, instructional architecture expertise, and stakeholder engagement skills.
 



 We're looking for someone who understands that successful ERP implementations are driven by user adoption—not just system deployment.
 



 The ideal candidate is comfortable working with business leaders, process owners, and technical teams to understand how people perform their jobs today, how those jobs will change in the future, and what learning interventions are needed to ensure a successful transition.
 



 This individual should be equally capable of facilitating executive workshops, analyzing business processes, developing learning strategies, and guiding instructional design teams to produce high\-quality enablement assets.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Enablement Strategy** 



* Define the overall enablement strategy supporting the ERP implementation.
* Develop role\-based learning and adoption strategies aligned to business objectives.
* Create learning roadmaps that support organizational readiness throughout the ERP lifecycle.
* Align learning deliverables with project milestones, deployment waves, and go\-live activities.



**Business Analysis \& Process Alignment** 



* Conduct Training Needs Analysis (TNA) across business functions.
* Perform Job Task Analysis (JTA) to identify critical job tasks and learning requirements.
* Facilitate workshops with business stakeholders, functional leads, process owners, and SMEs.
* Map business processes and ERP transactions to specific user roles.
* Identify business\-critical, compliance\-sensitive, and high\-risk workflows requiring focused enablement.
* Analyze changes between legacy systems and future\-state ERP processes to identify adoption risks.



**Learning Architecture** 



* Design role\-based curriculum architectures for Finance, Projects, Maintenance, Supply Chain, and other functional areas.
* Define learning objectives aligned to job performance rather than system navigation.
* Develop instructional frameworks that incorporate awareness, demonstration, guided practice, performance support, and reinforcement.
* Recommend appropriate learning modalities including:
* ClickLearn simulations
* Instructor\-led sessions
* Job aids
* Digital adoption content
* Performance support
* Knowledge assessments



**Stakeholder Engagement** 



* Serve as the primary learning and enablement advisor to customer stakeholders.
* Facilitate design workshops and content validation sessions.
* Build strong relationships with SMEs and business leaders to ensure learning reflects operational reality.
* Present recommendations and gain stakeholder alignment throughout the project.



**Content Governance** 



* Review instructional designs to ensure alignment with enablement strategy.
* Guide instructional designers and ClickLearn developers during production.
* Validate that learning assets accurately reflect business processes and system behaviour.
* Establish governance standards for curriculum structure, content quality, and review cycles.



**Change Enablement** 



* Partner with Organizational Change Management (OCM) teams to support user adoption.
* Identify potential adoption risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
* Align learning activities with communication, readiness, and change management initiatives.
* Support business readiness leading up to ERP deployment.



**Required Experience** 



* 10\+ years of experience in Learning Consulting, ERP Enablement, Organizational Change Management, or Enterprise Training.
* Experience supporting one or more enterprise ERP implementations, including:
* **IFS Cloud (mandatory)**
* SAP
* Oracle Cloud ERP
* Microsoft Dynamics 365
* Workday
* Infor
* Demonstrated experience conducting:
* Training Needs Analysis (TNA)
* Job Task Analysis (JTA)
* Role Mapping
* Curriculum Architecture
* Learning Strategy
* Strong understanding of enterprise business processes.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders and SMEs.
* Excellent facilitation and workshop management skills.
* Strong analytical, communication, and consulting skills.



**Preferred Experience** 




 Experience with one or more of the following:
 


* ClickLearn
* SAP Enable Now
* WalkMe
* Whatfix
* Digital Adoption Platforms (DAP)
* Learning Management Systems
* Business Process Mapping
* BPMN
* Prosci or equivalent OCM methodologies



**Key Deliverables** 




 The ERP Enablement Architect will lead or contribute to:
 


* Enablement Strategy
* Learning Strategy
* Training Needs Analysis
* Job Task Analysis
* Role Mapping
* Curriculum Architecture
* Learning Objective Matrix
* Learning Journeys
* Instructional Framework
* Scenario Library
* Assessment Strategy
* SME Workshop Facilitation
* Governance Documentation
* Design Validation
* Stakeholder Sign\-offs

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Join our global team for a career filled with opportunities to solve challenges both small and large, local and global, simple and complex.
   

  

**Wilhelmsen Ship Management** 
 is a third\-party ship manager providing a wide range of maritime services worldwide. With a strong workforce of shore\-based employees and seafarers, we operate one of the world's largest maritime networks across more than 70 countries.
   

  

**Wilhelmsen Ship Management Chennai** 
 is looking for a
 **Technical Support Engineer (PMS)** 
 to join the
 **Global PMS Support Team** 
 . This role combines Planned Maintenance System (PMS) technical support and PMS database project activities, requiring close interaction with vessel personnel, Technical Managers, Fleet Managers, and other stakeholders.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for providing PMS support to vessels, maintaining PMS technical data, supporting database improvement initiatives, and ensuring accuracy and quality of PMS spare parts data. The role requires excellent communication skills, strong customer service orientation, and the ability to work effectively with both vessel and shore\-based stakeholders.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Provide first\-line technical support for the Planned Maintenance System (PMS), responding to vessel and stakeholder queries in a timely and professional manner.
* Liaise with vessel crews, Technical Managers, Fleet Managers, and other stakeholders to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve PMS\-related issues.
* Maintain and update PMS databases, including equipment hierarchies, maintenance tasks, spare parts records, and technical documentation in accordance with company standards.
* Review maker's manuals, drawings, and technical documents to extract, validate, and standardize spare parts, component, and maintenance information.
* Perform quality assurance and data validation activities to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency of PMS data.
* Support PMS database Projects, migration, standardization, and continuous improvement across the fleet.
* Execute bulk data updates, cleaning, and verification activities to maintain high data quality standards.
* Prepare reports, analyze PMS data, and provide insights using Microsoft Excel and other reporting tools.
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives and special PMS\-related projects.
* Deliver a high level of customer service while supporting vessels and internal stakeholders.
* Support team objectives and undertake additional responsibilities assigned by the Team Lead.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in marine engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 1 year of experience in PMS support, maintenance planning, PMS database building, or related technical functions.
* Experience in PMS data management and technical support for vessels or maritime operations is preferred.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, lookups, filtering, data analysis, and reporting.
* Basic knowledge of SQL is desirable.
* Good understanding of vessel equipment, maintenance practices, and technical documentation.
* Experience in spare parts extraction, data standardization, and quality assurance activities.
* Knowledge of PMS component structure and maintenance job extraction from maker's manuals is an advantage.
* Previous onboard sailing experience will be considered an added benefit.


**Key Competencies**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
* Effective stakeholder management and customer service orientation.
* High attention to detail with a focus on quality and accuracy.
* Proactive, self\-motivated, and results\-oriented approach.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.

 Category: Software Development/ Engineering

 Position description:
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Aviation Subject Matter Expert (SME) with 12\+ years of experience across airlines, airports, aviation service providers, or aviation technology organizations.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess strong knowledge of airline and airport operations, aviation technology, passenger and baggage management, and aviation regulations, along with proven experience in stakeholder management, transformation consulting, and digital transformation initiatives.
   

  

 The candidate should be capable of bridging aviation business requirements and technology solutions, supporting transformation programs, identifying opportunities for process optimization, and working with business and technology stakeholders to deliver measurable outcomes.
   

  

 Your future duties and responsibilities
   

  

 Act as an Aviation Subject Matter Expert for airline, airport, and aviation technology transformation initiatives.
   

  

 Provide domain expertise across airline operations, airport operations, passenger services, baggage, ground handling, crew and flight operations.
   

  

 Understand and interpret relevant IATA standards, ICAO regulations, aviation safety and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Engage with business and technology stakeholders to understand business challenges, operational processes, and transformation objectives.
   

  

 Lead requirement gathering, business analysis, process mapping, gap analysis, and functional solution definition.
   

  

 Translate aviation business requirements into clear functional and technology requirements.
   

  

 Support aviation digital transformation and airport modernization programs.
   

  

 Identify and evaluate opportunities for AI/GenAI applications within aviation operations and customer journeys.
   

  

 Support cloud migration and technology modernization initiatives within aviation environments.
   

  

 Analyze operational data and develop meaningful analytics, dashboards, KPIs, and management reports.
   

  

 Work closely with product, technology, architecture, operations, and business teams to ensure successful solution delivery.
   

  

 Manage stakeholders across airlines, airports, technology teams, vendors, and senior leadership.
   

  

 Support change management and adoption activities associated with transformation programs.
   

  

 Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to iterative delivery.
   

  

 Identify operational risks, dependencies, process gaps, and improvement opportunities.
   

  

 Support solution evaluation and provide aviation\-domain inputs during technology/product selection.
   

  

 Drive continuous improvement and process optimization across aviation business functions.
   

  

**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
 10\+ years of aviation industry experience with airlines, airports, aviation service providers, or aviation technology organizations.
   

  

 Strong understanding of airline and airport operations.
   

  

 Strong knowledge of:
   

  

 IATA Standards
   

  

 ICAO Regulations
   

  

 Ground Handling Processes
   

  

 Passenger Journey Management
   

  

 Baggage Management Systems
   

  

 Crew \& Flight Operations
   

  

 Aviation Safety \& Compliance
   

  

 Transformation \& Consulting
   

  

 Proven experience in aviation digital transformation programs.
   

  

 Experience in airport modernization projects.
   

  

 Hands\-on exposure to AI/GenAI use cases in aviation.
   

  

 Experience with cloud migration / technology modernization programs.
   

  

 Experience with data analytics, reporting, dashboards, and KPI initiatives.
   

  

 Strong stakeholder management and transformation consulting experience.
   

  

 Strong business analysis and requirement\-gathering capabilities.
   

  

 Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
   

  

 Technology
   

  

 Experience with one or more of the following:
   

  

 Airport Operational Database (AODB)
   

  

 Departure Control Systems (DCS)
   

  

 Passenger Service Systems (PSS)
   

  

 Airport Management Systems (AMS)
   

  

 Good to Have
   

  

 Experience across both airline and airport ecosystems.
   

  

 Exposure to aviation SaaS/platform modernization.
   

  

 Experience with airline/airport system integration and API\-based architectures.
   

  

 Knowledge of passenger experience and digital customer journey transformation.
   

  

 Experience with cloud platforms and modern data platforms.
   

  

 Exposure to AI/ML, GenAI, automation, or intelligent operations in aviation.
   

  

 Experience working with global aviation clients and geographically distributed stakeholders.
   

  

 Experience in vendor management and technology partner coordination.
   

  

 Experience preparing business cases, transformation roadmaps, RFP/RFI responses, and solution proposals.
   

  

**SAFe Or Other Scaled Agile Experience.**
**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
 Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
   

  

 You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
   

  

 Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
   

  

 You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
   

  

 That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.
   

  

 Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

description:

**Lennox (NYSE: LII)** 
 Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry\-leading climate\-control solutions. title: CAPEX Excellence specialist
description:
**Support CAPEX planning, execution and reporting**
 Join NKT in a role that connects CAPEX governance, system support, and business improvement across an international organization. You will own day\-to\-day support, adoption, and continuous improvement of the CAPEX tool, helping teams work with consistent data, reliable reporting, and clear processes. This is a valuable opportunity to contribute to the green transition by supporting investment decisions across the business. Are you motivated by combining systems, process standards, and user support in one role?
   

  

**Keep CAPEX operations stable and consistent**
 In this role, you will act as the main business contact for the CAPEX tool and related process standards. You will support users, coordinate incidents and improvement requests with, and help maintain common templates, workflows, and reporting standards. The role also includes governance of master data, backlog prioritization, UAT coordination, and communication around releases and changes. You will work closely with CAPEX project managers, finance, procurement, IT, and process owners to support reliable planning, execution, and tracking across sites and functions.
   

  

**Your Responsibility Will Be To**
* Provide first\-line functional support and coordinate further support when needed
* Maintain user guides, SOPs, and training materials
* Govern usage standards, workflows, and documentation requirements
* Support reports and dashboards with consistent KPI definitions
* Coordinate UAT, releases and backlog priorities


 You will work across manufacturing sites and shared functions, in close collaboration with CAPEX project managers, site controllers, procurement and IT.
   

  

**Structured communicator with a clear quality focus**
 We are looking for someone who is service\-minded, and organized, with a practical approach to user support and process governance. You communicate clearly with both end users and management, work carefully with documentation and change control, and are comfortable balancing business needs with standard ways of working. The right person is initiative\-taking, detail\-oriented, and able to move issues forward while keeping compliance, auditability, and data quality in focus.
   

  

**You Also Have**
* 5\+ years of experience in CAPEX controlling, project execution, PMO, finance, or a similar area using CAPEX, ERP, or project portfolio tools
* Experience translating business needs into system requirements and supporting UAT, training, and change management
* Good understanding of data structures, reporting, and integrations with finance or ERP systems
* Experience acting as system or product owner
* Training or certification in ERP/PM systems or project management


**Help improve investment quality for a greener future**
 NKT is committed to developing a diverse organization and culture where people of diverse backgrounds can grow and are inspired to do their best. We are motivated to establish gender diversity at NKT and encourage all interested candidates to apply – even if you don’t tick all the boxes described. We believe that a diverse organization enables long\-term performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture creates a better work environment.
   

  

 In this role, you will be part of a collaborative international setting where you can broaden your skills in CAPEX governance, systems, reporting, and change processes. You will work with colleagues across business functions and sites, contribute to continuous improvement, and support reliable investment planning that matters to NKT’s ongoing journey and the wider green transition.
   

  

 “This role is ideal for someone who enjoys connecting systems, process standards, and user needs to create reliable CAPEX planning and reporting across the business,” says Hiring Manager, Karim Damiani
   

  

 Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!
   

  

 We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 30th September 2026\. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e\-mail.
   

  

 We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.
   

  

 Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!
   

  

**About NKT**
*NKT connects a greener world with high\-quality power cable technology and takes centre stage as the world moves towards green energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low\-, medium\- and high\-voltage power cable solutions enabling sustainable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology building the infrastructure for the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and employs 6,500 people. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3\.6 billion in 2025\. We connect a greener world. www.nkt.com*

title: Systems Control Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d’optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l’identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d’études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production.
   

  

 Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**
* Effectue l'intégration des composants et des produits. Toutes les activités qui englobent plusieurs composants et produits et concernées par l'intégration des solutions pour une performance et une opérabilité maximales. Gère les exigences, les spécifications et les flux de produits et de systèmes. Dirige les activités de validation et de vérification pour l'ensemble du produit/système, comprenant les tests au niveau du système. Responsable de la définition des exigences produits pour les équipes module/composant/sous\-traitants et partenaires. Gère l'interface entre les composants et les organisations d'exécution. Responsable de la gestion des transactions de CTQ/Risque au sein des équipes chargées de la conception des composants. Gère la configuration globale du produit et le système de contrôle de la configuration.
* Développer une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et une expertise technique acquise pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie.

* Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions.

Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent).
* Pour les rôles aux États\-Unis \- Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction).


**Caractéristiques souhaitées**

Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. title: Team Leader
description:
**Are you passionate about leading content operations and improving data quality for one of the world’s largest research databases?**
**Do you enjoy working with cross\-functional teams to solve complex content\-flow challenges and drive continuous improvement through data and automation?**
**About Our Team**
 WDOT (WORKs Domain Operations Team), part of Elsevier’s Research Data Platform (RDP) organization, is responsible for the completeness, quality, and end\-to\-end content flow of Scopus, one of the world’s largest abstract and citation databases. The team manages the operational standards, thresholds, and governance frameworks that determine what content enters Scopus, how quickly it is processed, and how fully it is covered. This includes content ingestion, Articles\-in\-Press (AiP) tracking, clustering and deduplication, citation correction, retractions, and content quality diagnostics. WDOT works closely with Content Sourcing (CSD), Publisher Relations (PRM), Source Data Management (SDM), and technology teams to keep Scopus complete, accurate, and trusted by the global research community.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Team Leader, you will manage a team of Process/Data Specialists responsible for the completeness, quality, and end\-to\-end content flow of Scopus. You will oversee operational performance across completeness standards, ingestion and production pipelines, clustering, deduplication, and quality diagnostics, ensuring targets are met and risks are escalated and resolved. You will serve as the senior escalation point for cross\-team issues, strengthen documentation and resilience to reduce single points of failure, and represent WDOT’s completeness and content\-flow priorities in cross\-domain governance forums.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead governance for Scopus completeness standards, quality benchmarks, and coverage\-gap closure.
* Oversee content ingestion and production workflows to ensure timely and accurate content flow into Scopus.
* Manage exceptions and escalations for records that fail completeness or quality checks, working with Content, CSD, PRM, SDM, and technology teams.
* Review Power BI dashboards and reporting metrics to ensure completeness, speed, coverage, and quality insights are accurate and actionable.
* Ensure discard, retraction, correction, citation\-accuracy, clustering, and deduplication processes are completed compliantly and on schedule.
* Lead, mentor, and develop Process/Data Specialists while setting clear goals, reviewing performance, and building an inclusive team culture.
* Act as the main escalation point for content\-flow issues, AiP delays, and completeness gaps requiring cross\-functional support.
* Drive process improvement, resource planning, automation, AI\-enabled data literacy, KPIs, and productivity initiatives for the completeness and content operations function.
* Proactive, assertive, and data\-curious, with the confidence to surface issues early, challenge the status quo, make informed decisions with incomplete information, persist through pushback, escalate when needed, and use data to identify what the numbers may indicate next.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in any discipline with 5\+ years of relevant experience in content operations, data/content quality, or scholarly publishing.
* Strong understanding of bibliographic database completeness, content ingestion pipelines, metadata standards, and content\-quality governance frameworks.
* Working knowledge of clustering, deduplication, retraction/correction, citation matching, and content ingestion or production workflows is preferred.
* Proficiency with Power BI or similar dashboarding tools to support metrics governance, reporting, and performance tracking.
* Understanding of AI technologies and data literacy to support automation, data\-driven insights, and continuous improvement.
* Strong people leadership skills, with experience managing experienced individual contributors and guiding talent development.
* Ability to provide direction to stakeholders, peers, managers, and direct reports while ensuring clarity on priorities, goals, OKRs, and KPIs.
* Comfortable managing ambiguity, handling escalations, collaborating across functions, and partnering with senior management on strategy and execution planning.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.
   

  

 Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.
   

  

**Working for You**
* We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents. Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
* Flexible Working Arrangement: work\-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work\-related challenges.
* Medical Screening: Your well\-being is a top priority.
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
* Long\-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
* Free Transport pick up and drop from the home \-office \- home (applies in Chennai)


**About The Business**
 A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals' advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

* Operating Model Design: document current\-state operating models, map organizational structures, and develop design options for future\-state models in GCC and shared services contexts

* Basic familiarity with GCC tooling ecosystems – ITSM, project management, and reporting platforms
* Awareness of AI trends in software delivery and engineering, including AI\-assisted development tools and their implications for GCC workforce design
* Strong analytical capabilities – ability to build models, conduct quantitative analysis, and synthesize data from multiple sources into clear, structured insights
* Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel; experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) is an advantage; strong written and verbal communication skills

 When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well\-being programs.
   

  

 At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage.
   

  

 If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen.

title: Engineer, Product Applications
description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Broadband Plasma Division (BBP) provides market\-leading patterned wafer optical inspection systems for leading\-edge IC manufacturing. Logic, foundry, and memory customers depend on BBP products to detect yield\-critical defects for process debug and excursion monitoring at advanced process nodes. BBP flagship products include the 29xx and 39xx series which leverage Broadband Plasma technology to capture a wide range of defects with ultimate sensitivity at the optical inspection speeds needed for inline defect monitoring.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
**Application Development Engineer**
**Responsibilities:**
* Customer support: Product value demonstration during beta testing, Head\-to\-Heads (H2H) and tools in the ramp phase, thereby enabling product penetration/adoption at world\-wide customers. This includes\-investigating semiconductor manufacturing yield issues and providing inspection solutions; creating \& sharing product value statements and use\-cases with engineering, marketing and sales groups; training customers and other applications engineers.
* Product Demonstration: Provide specific product demonstrations on all aspects of highly complex products to customers and assess potential applications to meet customer needs
* Product Characterization: Work on test plan development and execute detailed characterization of the tool/algorithm performance and provides clear feedback to the Engineering teams for product improvement, especially during Alpha/Beta tests.
* Problem Diagnosis/Troubleshooting: Respond to customer requests and perform routine to moderately complex problem diagnosis and problem resolution.
* Customer Relationship: Interacts with customers to educate and coordinate activities. Good working knowledge of customer use case and is expected to understand customer needs and improve customer relations.
* Training: Conduct customer product demonstrations and technical training including on\-site training of Field Applications Engineers and end users.
* Documentation: Document all test results and lessons learned in BKMs (Best Known Methods), training documents, Demo reports, or, Alpha/Beta test reports and transfer product knowledge to Field Applications teams.
* Presentation/Communication Skills: Generate demo and test reports and strong presentation skills for internal and customer review.


**Requirements:**
* We are looking for high energy, self\-driven and motivated engineers who are interested in working in High Tech. The semiconductor space is a fast paced, high stress environment that gives applications engineers a lot of autonomy to work and drive projects on their own. Ideal candidates appreciate the opportunity to have high levels of accountability, working well with limited supervision and thrive in a work environment where they can drive projects on their own.
* Candidate must have Master’s or bachelor's degree in Engineering, Physics, Material Science, or related fields.
* Must have excellent oral and written communication, organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills.
* Candidate must be a strong team player.
* \>50% travel will be required


**Minimum Qualifications**
 Master's Level Degree or work experience of 0 years , Bachelor's Level Degree or work experience of 1 years
   

  

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer*
 Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. Further, KLA does not work with any recruiters or third parties who charge such fees either directly or on behalf of KLA. Please ensure that you have searched KLA’s Careers website for legitimate job postings. KLA follows a recruiting process that involves multiple interviews in person or on video conferencing with our hiring managers. If you are concerned that a communication, an interview, an offer of employment, or that an employee is not legitimate, please send an email to talent.acquisition@kla.com to confirm the person you are communicating with is an employee. We take your privacy very seriously and confidentially handle your information.

title: Commercial excellence coordinator
description:
**Coordinate tender governance and project review processes**
 Are you interested in supporting commercial governance and decision\-making in a global organisation? As a Commercial Excellence Coordinator, you will coordinate tender approval and project review activities across Grid Solutions, helping ensure consistent commercial execution, effective risk management, and sustainable competitiveness. This is an opportunity to work with international teams, senior stakeholders, and cross\-functional partners while contributing to the continued growth of NKT. Do you want to be part of a collaborative global environment?
   

  

 Coordinate commercial reviews across global teams
   

  

 As a Commercial Excellence Coordinator, you will support the tender approval and project review processes across Grid Solutions. The role focuses on planning, documentation management, stakeholder coordination, meeting administration, workflow support, and process development. You will work closely with commercial teams, project execution teams, finance, and leadership stakeholders to ensure information is accurate, distributed on time, and properly documented. Your contribution will help maintain governance standards, improve decision\-making, and ensure consistency across regions and hubs.
   

  

**Your Responsibility Will Be To**
* Coordinate tender approval meetings, agendas, participants, and documentation according to approval requirements
* Manage document quality reviews, distribution, archiving, and approval records
* Prepare and distribute decisions, actions, and meeting minutes within agreed timelines
* Coordinate project review meetings based on project risk categorisation and governance requirements
* Maintain workflow automation tools and support continuous process improvements


 This position reports to the Head of Commercial Excellence and collaborates with global Grid Solutions stakeholders across commercial, project execution, installation management, finance, and leadership teams. Location: NKT office location to be confirmed. Limited travel may be required.
   

  

**Organised coordinator with effective stakeholder collaboration**
 The ideal person enjoys bringing structure to complex activities, managing competing priorities, and working with colleagues across different locations and functions. They communicate clearly, build trusted working relationships, and maintain attention to detail even when handling multiple deadlines. They are accountable, consistent, and committed to high\-quality outcomes. A continuous improvement mindset and an interest in improving processes and ways of working will support long\-term performance in this role.
   

  

**You Also Have**
* Relevant degree in Business, Engineering, Finance, or equivalent
* Experience maintaining process methodologies, templates, and guidelines for tender and/or project reviews
* Experience working in global matrix organisations
* Basic understanding of risk management and project governance principles
* Professional written and spoken English
* Experience with SharePoint and Power Automate


 Contribute to efficient decisions for a greener tomorrow
   

  

 We aim to create a workplace where people of all backgrounds are valued, supported, and able to do their best work.
   

  

 We are dedicated to increasing gender diversity at NKT and welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. We welcome varied backgrounds and career paths—even if you don’t meet every single requirement. We believe inclusive teams contribute to positive results and create a better everyday work environment.
   

  

 This role offers opportunities to develop your career within an international organisation while collaborating with colleagues across regions and functions. You will expand your knowledge of commercial governance, project reviews, workflow automation, and stakeholder management while contributing to process improvements that support NKT’s continued growth and the green transition.
   

  

 Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!
   

  

 We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than
 **31st October 2026** 
 . Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e\-mail.
   

  

 We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.
   

  

 Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!
   

  

**About NKT**
*Join a diverse and international team within NKT’s Grid Solutions business, supporting the delivery and operation of reliable power grids worldwide. We deliver HVAC onshore cable systems and provide specialist service for AC and DC cable systems onshore and offshore. As a global organisation with operations across Europe, Australia, the United States, and the Middle East, Grid Solutions works closely with customers around the world and across the full lifecycle of power cable systems.*
*At NKT, we are all Connectors. We connect to develop leading power cable technologies that enable the world’s transition to renewable energy \- and we stay connected to grow as people and professionals. As a company, NKT connects a greener world with high\-quality power cable technology and plays a key role as the world moves towards clean energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low\-, medium\- and high\-voltage power cable solutions enabling reliable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology, building the infrastructure from the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today.*
*NKT is headquartered in Denmark, operates from more than 30 countries worldwide, and employs 6,500 people globally. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3\.6 billion in 2025\. NKT \- We connect a greener world. www.nkt.com*

title: Senior associate, Generalist, Business Support Unit, SME Banking
description:
Business Function
   

  

 Corporate and Investment Banking provides corporate customers with a full range of commercial banking products and services, including cash management services, current accounts, time deposits, trade finance, working capital finance, term loans, and foreign exchange. Through our continued commitment, DBS has cultivated long\-standing relationships with its customers in the region that are based on account relationship management, service differentiation, product development, and rigorous credit standards.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 This senior position in the Business Support Unit (BSU) is responsible for leading the provision of documentation and credit\-related services, overseeing the efficient processing of loan application disbursements, and managing complex post\-disbursement activities. The role also involves contributing to policy development and process enhancements for all Business Segments that is Large Mid and SME
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

 Fulfil all responsibilities in relation to:
   

  

 Strong Knowledge of Legal Documentation and Mortgage Processes
   

  

 This requirement is critical for the senior BSU professional, as the role inherently involves extensive interaction with various legal and security documents. It signifies an in\-depth understanding of:
   

  

* Offer Letters and Facility Documents: Expertise in drafting, reviewing, and executing these documents for IBG 3\&4 customers, ensuring strict adherence to approved credit and business terms, Master LO templates, and guidelines from Group Legal and Product Owners. This includes acting as a primary checker and approver.
* In\-house Security Documents: Comprehensive knowledge of various security instruments such as Hypothecation, Cash Margin, and Mortgage. This extends to developing, refining, and maintaining templates for these documents in line with approved credit memos and collaborating with the Credit Control Unit (CCU) for process completion.
* Regulatory Compliance: A thorough grasp of the legal and regulatory frameworks governing corporate banking products, credit operations, and loan administration, ensuring all documentation complies with internal and external standards.
* Mortgage\-Specific Expertise: Given the mention of "mortgage processes," the candidate must possess specialized knowledge of the legal intricacies involved in mortgage\-backed loans, including creation, perfection, and enforcement of mortgage securities, and related documentation. This includes overseeing desktop valuations and collateral audits.
* Risk Mitigation: The ability to identify potential legal and documentation\-related risks and implement strategies to mitigate them, contributing to a robust credit risk management framework.


 Proven Experience in Process Streamlining and Automation
   

  

 For a senior position, this goes beyond mere participation in process improvements. It requires a demonstrable track record of leadership in transforming operational workflows to achieve greater efficiency and accuracy. This involves:
   

  

* Identifying Bottlenecks: The capability to analyze existing documentation and credit\-related processes within the BSU, identifying inefficiencies, manual dependencies, and areas prone to errors.
* Designing and Implementing Solutions: Proposing, developing, and leading the implementation of innovative solutions, potentially leveraging technology, to automate repetitive tasks, reduce manual intervention, and enhance process flow. This could include enhancements to document management systems or integration with core banking platforms.
* Optimizing Workflows: Re\-engineering end\-to\-end processes related to loan application disbursement and post\-disbursement activities, ensuring seamless execution from initiation to closure.
* Technological Proficiency: Leveraging advanced knowledge of MS Office, core banking systems, document management systems, and credit services platforms, with an added advantage for experience in data analytics tools, to drive automation initiatives effectively.
* Change Management: Leading and guiding teams through process changes, ensuring smooth adoption of new systems and workflows, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.


 Ability to Drive Operational Efficiency and Reduce Turnaround Time (TAT)
   

  

 This requirement emphasizes the candidate's strategic and results\-oriented approach to BSU operations. It implies a direct impact on the unit's productivity and responsiveness:
   

  

* Strategic Oversight: The ability to oversee and optimize all miscellaneous activities related to disbursement across various product offerings, consistently identifying areas for process improvement that directly impact efficiency.
* Timely Report Submissions: Strategically managing and coordinating with Legal and Valuation agencies to ensure timely submission of reports and resolution of complex issues, which directly impacts TAT for loan processing.
* Expedited Exception Closure: Driving the resolution of critical exception items (e.g., Insurance, Internal covenants) through proactive follow\-up with RMs and customers, and collaborating closely with CCU to ensure timely and effective closure, thereby reducing delays.
* Vendor Management Efficiency: Proactively managing relationships with external agencies/vendors to ensure timely and accurate vendor payments and resolving disputes, contributing to smoother operations and preventing delays.
* Performance Metrics: Establishing and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) for operational efficiency and TAT, and continuously seeking ways to meet or exceed these targets.


 Strong Business Support and Stakeholder Management Skills
   

  

 In a senior BSU role, effective collaboration and communication are paramount. This requirement highlights the need for a leader who can effectively interact with diverse internal and external parties:
   

  

* Internal Stakeholder Collaboration: Expertly liaising with a wide range of internal stakeholders, including Senior Relationship Managers, Credit Heads, CCU Leadership, Operations Management, Product Team, Legal, Compliance, and Finance teams. This involves providing expert guidance, resolving issues, and ensuring alignment on processes and policies.
* External Stakeholder Relationship Management: Proactively managing relationships with external entities such as BSU HO, Strategic Vendors, Empaneled Senior Legal Counsel, Lead Valuers and representatives, and Key Corporate Customers. This includes overseeing their performance and ensuring their contributions support the bank's objectives.
* Primary Liaison and Escalation Point: Acting as a key point of contact for RMs and customers regarding intricate post\-disbursement documents and critical exception tracking, effectively handling escalations and ensuring satisfactory resolutions.
* Influencing and Negotiating: The ability to influence outcomes, negotiate effectively, and build consensus among various parties to achieve operational goals and improve service delivery.
* Mentorship and Guidance: Mentoring and guiding junior team members in documentation and credit operations processes, fostering a strong and collaborative team environment.
* Communication Excellence: Possessing exceptional verbal and written communication skills to articulate complex information clearly and persuasively, facilitating effective collaboration and decision\-making across all stakeholder groups.


 Technical Competencies
   

  

* The job holder needs to have advanced knowledge of MS Office, core banking systems, document management systems, and various credit services platforms. Experience with data analytics tools is an advantage. Proficiency in systems related to legal documentation and mortgage processes is required.


 Work Relationship
   

  

 To work with:
   

  

* Internal: Head BSU, Product Team, Senior Relationship Managers, Credit Heads, CCU Leadership, Operations Management.
* External: BSU HO, Strategic Vendors, Empaneled Senior Legal Counsel, Lead Valuers and representatives, Key Corporate Customers.


 DBS India \- Culture \& Behaviors
   

  

* Drive Performance Through Value Based Propositions
* Ensure Customer Focus by Delighting Customers \& Reduce Complaints
* Build Pride and Passion to Protect, Maintain and Enhance DBS’ Reputation
* Enhance Knowledge Base, Build Skill Sets \& Develop Competencies
* Invest in Team Building \& Motivation through Ideation \& Innovation

* Ability to build international networks and collaborate effectively across global teams
* Deep customer orientation paired with a business\-minded approach

**Additional Information**

title: Procurement Specialist
description:
**Position** 




**Procurement SME** 




  





**About JiBe** 




 JiBe is the leading cloud based fully integrated ERP system for the shipping industry. Our goal is to allow shipping companies to improve productivity, efficiency and safety levels, while reducing costs. JiBe ERP enables increased automation and streamlining of processes, creating pre\-defined workflows and reducing the usage of email and paper
 



 We are looking for candidates who can be the ambassador of the procurement module of JiBe to all its clients.
 



 The Senior Procurement SME leverages their in\-depth knowledge of procurement processes and ERP systems to drive the successful implementation, optimization, and support of Procurement and procurement related modules. The focus is on ensuring a successful implementation of JiBe and enabling client organizations to streamline procurement workflows, achieve cost savings, and improve overall supply chain management through technology\-driven innovations using the JiBe ecosystem.
 



  





**Job responsibilities** 



* Ensure the successful implementation of the JiBe procurement, Logistics, Inventory, Contracts and Supplier Registry module by providing the best possible training and management of change processes.
* Create and manage comprehensive training materials, including user manuals, guides, video tutorials to support the education and onboarding of clients in using procurement modules.
* Maintain up\-to\-date documentation of system configurations, procurement workflows, and processes.
* Ensure that all the process changes, enhancements and configurations are fully documented for future reference.
* Analyze and document clients’ existing procurement process, identifying gaps \& opportunities for improvement and aligning them with the system capabilities.
* Provide comprehensive training to end users on procurement functionalities within the system, ensuring smooth adoption and operation of the system.
* Guide and support the implementation team to configure, customize the procurement module to meet specific client requirements
* Provide ongoing support to the clients’ posts implementation, troubleshooting any procurement related issues and offering system updates or process improvements when necessary.
* Guide and mentor other Procurement SMEs, providing them with the necessary support, feedback, and training to enhance their knowledge and review their work, ensuring that the deliverables meet the quality standards and align with the overall scope and client expectations.
* Work with product owners and managers in ensuring user stories are delivering the intended user, product and business requirements.



  





**Qualifications and Skills** 



* Strong communication skills, verbal and oral and fluent in English.
* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Procurement, or related fields or an equivalent knowledge through work experience.
* Proven experience with Marine ERP Systems or other supply chain platforms such as SAP, Oracle.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in Marine Procurement or supply chain management, preferably within a Shipping company.
* Ability to create user friendly training materials, including manuals, and conduct workshops.
* Strong Presentation and facilitation skills to conduct training sessions for clients and internal teams.
* Ability to map business processes to ERP System functionalities.
* Ability to analyze business processes and provide solutions to optimize procurement workflows.
* Skilled with change management principles to ensure smooth transitions during implementation, including handling resistance and facilitating user training and adoption.
* You can apply agile analysis techniques in transforming business requirements into technical specifications.



  





**Additional Qualifications** 



* Certification in project management (e.g. PMP, Prince2\) is a plus but not mandatory.
* Team player with good interpersonal and communication skills
* Strong data analysis skills for reviewing procurement data and ensuring accuracy of ERP.
* Experience in Accounting and invoices processes is advantageous.

title: Catalog Manager
description:
**Job Summary** 




 The Catalogue Executive is responsible for managing the organization's product catalogue across all categories, ensuring every product is accurately represented in catalogues, quotation tools, and internal systems. The role focuses on catalogue accuracy, product data management, new product launches, SKU management, pricing updates, and supporting seamless collaboration between Category, Procurement, Design, Sales, Operations, and Technology teams. The objective is to maintain ascalable, standardized, and error\-free catalogue that enables excellent customer experience and
 



 efficient business operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Catalogue Management:** 



* Manage and maintain the master product catalogue, ensuring all product information is accurate, standardized, and up to date across all cities and platforms.
* Create, modify, and archive product records, ensuring discontinued products are removed and new products are added as per approved timelines.
* Maintain a consistent category hierarchy, product groupings, and catalogue version control.



  





**2\. Product Data Management:** 



* Ensure complete and accurate product information, including specifications, dimensions, finishes, materials, warranties, images, and descriptions.
* Validate product data received from vendors and internal stakeholders before publishing it in the catalogue
* Maintain data consistency across catalogues, quotation tools, and other business systems.



  





**3\. Pricing Management:** 



* Update product pricing, discounts, and commercial information based on approved price revisions from the Category and Procurement teams.
* Verify pricing accuracy before releasing updates to ensure error\-free quotations and customer proposals.
* Maintain historical pricing records and support periodic price revisions.



  





**4\. Product Launch Management:** 



* Coordinate the end\-to end catalogue readiness for new product launches, ensuring all product information, images, pricing, and documentation are available.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to ensure products are launched within committed timelines.
* Support the preparation of product launch materials, catalogues, and internal communication.



  





**5\. SKU Management:** 



* Create and maintain unique SKU codes for all products while ensuring there are no duplicate or incorrect entries.
* Update SKU mappings whenever products are modified, discontinued, or introduced.
* Maintain the master SKU database to support inventory, quotation, and reporting systems.



  





**6\. Quote Builder \& System Management:** 



* Coordinate with the Tech team to upload new products, pricing updates, and configuration changes into the Quote Builder and related systems.
* Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate data accuracy before system releases.
* Report and follow up on system issues to ensure minimal disruption to business operations.



  





**7\. Vendor Coordination:** 



* Liaise with vendors to collect product catalogues, images, specifications, pricing, warranty information, and other required documentation.
* Follow up with vendors to ensure timely submission of updated product information.
* Maintain organized records of all vendor documents and communications.



  





**8\. Documentation Management:** 



* Maintain and regularly update product rate cards, technical specifications, installation guidelines, comparison sheets, and other catalogue\-related documents.
* Ensure all documentation follows company standards and version control practices.
* Support the preparation of internal reference documents for Sales, Design, and Operations teams.



  





**9\. Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 



* Collaborate closely with Category, Procurement, Partners to ensure seamless catalogue updates.
* Communicate product changes, launches, and pricing revisions to relevant stakeholders in a timely manner.
* Support cross\-functional initiatives aimed at improving catalogue quality and business efficiency.



  





**10\. Catalogue Quality Control:** 



* Conduct regular audits to verify the accuracy of product information, pricing, images, specifications, and category mappings.
* Identify and resolve catalogue discrepancies before they impact customer quotations or project execution.
* Recommend process improvements to enhance catalogue accuracy, consistency, and operational efficiency.



  





**Educational Qualification:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Data Management or Information Management, or a related field.
* Experience in the Interior Industry is an added advantage.



  





**Experience:** 



* Minimum 2 years of experience in Catalogue Management, Product Management, Procurement Coordination, or Data Management.



  





**SKILLS REQUIRED:** 



* Advanced Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets
* Data Validation
* Basic ERP/CRM understanding
* Version Control Behavioural Skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to coordinate effectively with cross\-functional teams and external vendors
* High attention to detail and accuracy
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Process\-oriented with a focus on continuous improvement
* Ownership, accountability, and a proactive approach to work
* Adaptability and willingness to learn new systems and processes

title: Team Lead - Revenue Ops
description:
