 Arcadia is the AI\-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI\-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
 ****cut carbon****
 .
   

  

**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**
* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI\-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all. .
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.


 Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
   

  

**Benefits**
* "Remote first" culture \- work anywhere in the continental US as long as you have a reliable internet connection
* Flexible PTO \- no accrued hours and no limit on the number of vacation days exempt employees can take each year
* 11 annual holidays
* 10 days sick leave
* Up to 2 weeks bereavement leave
* 2 volunteer days off
* 2 professional development days off
* Parental Leave Benefits for ALL parents
* 75\-95% employer cost coverage for medical, dental, and vision benefits for employees and dependents


****Celebrating Diversity and Inclusion****
 Here at Arcadia, we cultivate diversity, celebrate individuality, and believe unique perspectives are key to our collective success in creating a clean energy future. Arcadia is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation by emailing careers@arcadia.com prior to completing your application.
   

  

 What We’re Looking For
   

  

****Years of Experience: 5\-8 Years****
**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Problem Solver: Grasp concepts and workflows, come up with a basic implementation plan and set up dashboard views (Jira/Excel/R/Tableau/SQL/Python) to track the assigned work to completion in a time bound manner
* Risk Identification: Analyse the Pro\-s and Cons of existing workflows, make data driven decisions for prioritization and execution.
* Process: Identify the top 3 major blockers for the team (Pareto), enable the team to solve the problem through upskilling, Goal setting and achieving the same
* Product: Identify major tech glitches in workflow, using QC tools to identify team’s output, give insights to Product team to enable quicker, easier deliveries in Onboarding
* People: Understand Team's capabilities, provide regular constructive feedback via 1:1s, setting KRAs and nurture them to step into new responsibilities; work with peers in other teams to setup processes across departments and workflows
* Leadership: Represent Arcadia in Customer/Atlanta Leadership calls, understand the customer pain points and bridge them using workflow modifications and Change management capabilities; Work with Directors, Be in\-tune with the direction of company's growth, ready to explore new domains and challenges
* Reporting: Ensure KPIs are published and reviewed on a daily, weekly, monthly basis and perform analysis on any behaviours / processes that could impact on data integrity; Improve and drive metrics from X to Y in a planned manner


**What You’ll Do**
* Ensure adherence to existing processes \& setting up appropriate dip sticks
* Facilitate root cause analysis for incident reports and identify continuous improvement opportunities in areas of people, tools, and/or process changes
* Collaborate with customer support teams to provide technical support for Urjanet’s data feed and APIs
* Lead best practices for project management including planning, executing, monitoring, and closure of projects
* Manage a portfolio of customer accounts ranging from enterprise to small scale engagements
* Identify capacity requirements to support monitoring SLAs within customer contracts
* Collaborate with account management team for renewal, expansion and churn prevention activities
* Provide feedback to product management team by identifying key product changes to improve efficiencies and overall customer experience
* Coordinate with Urjanet’s offshore teams to ensure data deliveries are on schedule, meeting quality standards, and SLA\-compliant
* Develop, maintain, \& improve processes surrounding customer acceptance of Urjanet data delivered
* Create/update internal \& external documentation to help support all customer processes
* Support ongoing plan to delegate Atlanta support operations tasks to India as the company grows


**What We’re Looking For**
* Degree graduates in BE/B.Tech, Computer Applications, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, and Commerce
* Background in SaaS company / FinTech / BPO
* \>\= 5 years of professional service with at least 3 years as a Team Lead on papers, solution implementation and/or technical support experience
* Data Proficiency: Handling utility data; Microsoft Office Suite, Software exposure such as JIRA, Tableau, R and Power BI
* Strong knowledge in RCA, KRA and Benchmarking
* Experience in customer account/relationship management, Escalation handling, good communication and articulation skills
* Experience managing large scale projects, ability to adapt to changing work environments and priorities
* Very strong goal orientation, work ethic and sense of personal accountability
* High energy, passion, motivational skills, team building skills and a strong ability to work with minimal direction and guidance
* Individual contributors with team handling experience also can apply
* Experience in Banking \& Financial Services, data aggregation, energy or fintech industry is a plus
* Applicants must be willing and able to work rotating shifts
* Experience working with and/or providing technical support for APIs is a plus

description:

 Full\-Time

 4\+ years

 Cybersecurity / Enterprise SaaS / AI Security

 Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a global enterprise cybersecurity company building a new generation of products to secure
 **AI agents, LLM\-powered applications, and the data they access** 
 .
   

  

 As the AI security platform moves toward general availability, customers, partners, and internal teams need documentation that is
 **accurate, technically rigorous, and easy to act on** 
 .
   

  

 You'll own the documentation ecosystem across product guides, API references, deployment and integration documentation, and release materials, working closely with
 **Go engineers, Product Managers, and Support** 
 .
   

  

 We're looking for a Technical Writer who is comfortable reading code and API specifications, can explain complex security and infrastructure concepts clearly, and uses AI tools to work more efficiently without compromising technical accuracy.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Own end\-user, administrator, and API documentation for the AI security platform, from initial structure through ongoing maintenance.
* Create deployment and integration guides for gateway, endpoint, cloud discovery, and platform components, including code samples and configuration references.
* Write release notes and in\-product help, and maintain documentation standards and style guidelines.
* Work directly with engineers to generate and maintain API documentation from OpenAPI and protobuf definitions, keeping documentation aligned with product releases.
* Review technical examples and documentation for accuracy, consistency, and usability.
* Gather feedback from customers and Support to identify documentation gaps and improve clarity.
* Use AI tools to draft, review, update, and maintain documentation at scale while ensuring all technical content is properly validated.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 4\+ years of technical writing experience for developer\- or administrator\-facing B2B software.
* Ability to read Go, Python, OpenAPI, and protobuf well enough to accurately document APIs, configurations, and code examples.
* Experience with docs\-as\-code workflows, including Markdown, Git, static site generators, and CI\-based publishing.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or related technical concepts, or a demonstrated ability to learn complex technical domains quickly.
* Excellent written English with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Practical experience using AI writing and coding assistants, combined with a rigorous process for reviewing and validating their output.
* Comfortable collaborating with distributed engineering and product teams across time zones.
* Strong ownership and attention to technical detail.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience documenting cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, or AI/ML products.
* Experience with API documentation and publishing tools such as Redocly, Stoplight, Docusaurus, or equivalent.
* Basic Python or scripting skills for documentation automation.
* Experience working directly with engineering teams in a docs\-as\-code environment.


 AI\-First Team
   

  

 AI is a core part of how this team works.
   

  

 During the interview process, you'll be asked about how you use AI in your documentation workflow, including the tools you rely on, how you validate their output, and where AI has changed the way you work.
   

  

 We're looking for people who use AI as a
 **force multiplier for research, productivity, problem\-solving, and documentation quality** 
 , while maintaining a high bar for technical accuracy.
   

  

 Why Join
   

  

* Help shape the documentation for a new AI security platform as it moves toward general availability.
* Work directly with engineers, product teams, security researchers, and customers on emerging AI security challenges.
* Own a documentation ecosystem spanning APIs, integrations, deployment, administration, and product education.
* Work on technically complex products at the intersection of cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, and agentic AI.
* Join a highly technical, distributed team where AI is a core part of daily work.


 Pragmatike is committed to a fair, transparent, and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

   \* NFPA
 



   \* API standards where relevant
 



   \* NACE / AMPP where relevant for corrosion and coatings
 



 \* Manufacturer Technical Documentation
 



   \* valve manufacturers
 



   \* pump manufacturers
 



   \* HVAC manufacturers
 



   \* electrical equipment
 



   \* automation
 



   \* piping systems
 



   \* GRE/GRP
 



   \* steel
 



   \* cables
 



   \* switchboards
 



   \* sensors
 



   \* motors
 



   \* heat exchangers
 



   \* filters
 



   \* sewage systems
 



   \* BWTS
 



   \* scrubber equipment
 



   \* etc.
 



 \* EvoMarine Internal Knowledge
 



   \* previously approved BOMs
 



   \* previous RFQs
 



   \* successful suppliers
 



   \* approved technical submittals
 



   \* previous material substitutions
 



   \* lessons learned
 



   \* NCRs
 



   \* commissioning issues
 



   \* preferred manufacturers
 



   \* historic pricing
 



   \* delivery performance
 



   \* supplier ratings
 



   \* technical clarifications from previous projects
 



  





 All standards and controlled documents must be obtained legally from the official publisher, classification society or approved subscription service.
 



  





 We should not build the system around uncontrolled PDF copies from the internet.
 



  





**2\. Technical Requirement Matrices** 




  





 Uploading standards is not enough.
 



  





 We need to convert engineering knowledge into structured rules.
 



  





 For every major material category, we should create a Technical Requirement Matrix.
 



  





 For example, for a valve, the system should know that “3\-inch valve” is not enough information.
 



  





 Before procurement can proceed, it should check for information such as:
 



  





 \* valve type
 



 \* nominal diameter
 



 \* pressure rating
 



 \* design pressure
 



 \* operating pressure
 



 \* design temperature
 



 \* operating temperature
 



 \* fluid/service
 



 \* material of body
 



 \* trim material
 



 \* seat material
 



 \* end connection
 



 \* flange standard
 



 \* actuator/manual operation
 



 \* fail\-open/fail\-close requirement
 



 \* fire\-safe requirement
 



 \* class approval
 



 \* marine approval
 



 \* testing requirements
 



 \* certification requirement
 



 \* applicable standard
 



 \* quantity
 



 \* delivery location
 



 \* required delivery date
 



  





 If mandatory fields are missing, the AI should automatically return questions to the Project Manager or Engineer.
 



  





 The same approach should be developed for:
 



  





 \* pipes
 



 \* fittings
 



 \* flanges
 



 \* valves
 



 \* pumps
 



 \* motors
 



 \* cables
 



 \* electrical equipment
 



 \* instrumentation
 



 \* HVAC
 



 \* heat exchangers
 



 \* structural steel
 



 \* welding consumables
 



 \* insulation
 



 \* coatings
 



 \* GRE/GRP
 



 \* machinery
 



 \* automation components
 



  





 Each technical family should have its own checklist.
 



  





**3\. Hierarchy of Technical Requirements** 




  





 The system must understand that not every project follows the same standards.
 



  





 The applicable rules should depend on the project.
 



  





 For example:
 



  





 Commercial / Cruise vessel:
 



  





 Contract / Client Specification
 



 → Classification Society
 



 → IMO/SOLAS/MARPOL
 



 → Engineering Standard
 



 → Manufacturer Requirement
 



  





 U.S. Navy project:
 



  





 Contract / SOW
 



 → NAVSEA requirements
 



 → NAVSEA Standard Items / JFMM / applicable MIL\-SPEC
 



 → ABS or other class requirements if applicable
 



 → engineering standards
 



 → manufacturer requirements
 



  





 MARAD project:
 



  





 Contract / Vessel Specification
 



 → MARAD / USCG requirements
 



 → 46 CFR
 



 → ABS/class
 



 → applicable engineering standards.
 



  





 The AI must never assume that one standard automatically overrides another.
 



  





 The hierarchy must be configured by project.
 



  





  





 Qualification :
 



 M. Tech in marine Engineering
 



 Must have Sailing Experience or Working knowledge of the Maritime Laws and Codes and Standards

description:
**Drive Customer Success as an Onboarding \& Implementation Specialist – Tekla Structures**
 Are you a seasoned structural engineer with deep expertise in Tekla Structures who thrives on solving complex technical challenges and guiding clients toward operational success? Trimble is seeking an Onboarding and Implementation Specialist to join our Professional Services team in India. In this high\-impact position, you will own the end\-to\-end implementation journey for enterprise clients, turning complex steel and concrete detailing requirements into streamlined, best\-practice workflows.
   

  

**About Us**
 Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose\-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com
   

  

**Our Division:** 
 Trimble's Professional Services team provides the strategic framework, technical onboarding, and implementation rigor that enable engineering and detailing firms to maximize ROI from their software investments across the structural lifecycle.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Great**
 Reporting directly to the Manager of Professional Services, Training \& Onboarding (India), you will serve as the trusted technical advisor for net\-new and existing Tekla Structures accounts across India. You will have full ownership over discovery meetings, workflow customization, and client success roadmaps. Working at the intersection of sales, customer support, and global product development, you will play a central role in conveying real\-world customer feedback directly back to core engineering teams to influence future software capabilities.
   

  

 Key Exciting Responsibilities
   

  

* End\-to\-End Onboarding Execution: Lead full\-lifecycle software onboarding and implementation programs for new and existing clients utilizing Tekla Structures (Steel and Concrete configurations).
* Workflow Discovery \& Problem Solving: Conduct deep\-dive technical discovery sessions to analyze client requirements, troubleshoot output customization challenges, and engineer tailored structural detailing workflows.
* Implementation Collateral \& Best Practices: Develop high\-grade onboarding materials, system configurations, and best\-practice guidelines that empower clients to adopt optimal structural detailing standards.
* Project Delivery \& Client Tracking: Help clients establish realistic deployment milestones, deliver ongoing technical guidance to protect timelines, and meticulously track project deliverables and engagement logs.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Value Advocacy: Serve as the primary onboarding anchor across Sales, Support, and Product Development teams, while actively presenting the value of Professional Services to prospective clients.


**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Tekla Structures Deep\-Dive Expertise: 4–5 years of direct, hands\-on experience using Tekla Structures across Steel and Concrete modules.
* Domain \& Industry Experience: 6–7 years of hands\-on structural detailing and design experience with strong domain mastery in structural steel and reinforced concrete workflows.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil, Structural, or Mechanical Engineering.
* Communication \& Engagement: Fluent written and spoken English with exceptional interpersonal skills to command credibility across client C\-suites and job\-site engineering teams.
* Independent Execution: Strong diagnostic capability to troubleshoot software issues independently, manage tight schedules, and drive project success with minimal supervision.


**Bonus Points For**
* Multilingual Capability: Fluency in spoken Hindi to engage effectively across diverse regional client bases in India.
* Global Design Codes: Direct experience executing structural detailing projects according to international engineering codes and standards.
* Customer\-Centric Mindset: Highly organized, detail\-oriented approach with an eagerness to learn complementary Trimble software products.


**Logistics**
* Location: Chennai.
* Job Type: Full\-Time.


 Why You'll Love Working With Us
   

  

 At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real\-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
   

  

* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose\-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
* Collaborate with like\-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
* Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self\-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
* Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.

 Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

 At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). title: Product Analyst
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a Product Analyst with a background in technology, or a related field. In this role, you will communicate with team members and business partners on a regular basis. The Business Analyst will analyze our requirements and design solutions to meet those requirements. You will also be responsible for testing, implementing, and maintaining software applications to improve business processes.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Elicits, analyzes, specifies, and validates the business needs of stakeholders, be they customers or end users.
* Collaborates with project sponsors to determine project scope and vision.
* Conducts interviews to gather customer requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.
* Identifies and establishes scope and parameters of requirements analysis on a project\-by\-project basis to define project impact, outcome criteria, and metrics.
* Works with stakeholders and project team to prioritize collected requirements.
* Researches, reviews, and analyses the effectiveness of existing requirements\-gathering processes and develop strategies for enhancing or further applying these processes.
* Helps conduct research on products to meet agreed upon requirements and to support purchasing efforts.
* Participates in the QA of solutions to ensure features and functions have been enabled and optimized.
* Participates in the selection of any requirements documentation software solutions that the organization may opt to use.
* Analyzes and verifies requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.
* Develops and utilizes standard templates to accurately and concisely write requirements specifications.
* Translates conceptual customer requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is comprehensible to developers/project team.
* Creates process models, specifications, diagrams, and charts to provide direction to developers and/or the project team.
* Develops and conduct peer reviews of the business requirements to ensure that requirement specifications are correctly interpreted.
* Assists with the interpretation of customer requirements into feasible options, and communicating these back to the business stakeholders.
* Manages and tracks the status of requirements throughout the project lifecycle; enforce and redefine as necessary.
* Communicates changes, enhancements, and modifications of business requirements — verbally or through written documentation — to project managers, sponsors, and other stakeholders so that issues and solutions are understood.
* You will report to manager \- IT


**The Essentials \- You Will Have**
 Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience
   

  

 Typically requires 8 years of related experience (project Management, Process Improvement and data management experience)
   

  

 Communicate the plan and priorities for the Program Increment and define the PI goals
   

  

 Drive release behavior, incenting discipline and quality over speed
   

  

 Determine resource requirements and partner with Tech Lead or Business Owner on sourcing talent
   

  

 Integrates change management elements needed to support the desired state;
   

  

 Track key delivery issues and risks and escalating as needed.
   

  

 Accountable for validation of acceptance criteria met before accepting completed features and definition of done
   

  

 Overall responsibility to manage the Epic and Feature backlogs and Themes for measuring to key objectives, value delivery.
   

  

 Collaborate and shape design, development and implementation requirements with partners and engineering team members.
   

  

 Be responsible for training and support documentation, as well as business readiness \& service transition
   

  

 Provides consultative support in financial management, organizational change, vendor management, and operational excellence to business lead technology initiatives and to our business or enterprise shared services teams
   

  

 Provide analysis on key business drivers and metrics using the latest analytics \& visualization technology.
   

  

 Define the needed business cases with project team and process owner, defining business outcomes, including current baseline and future target metrics, such as leading and lagging indicators, and linking to strategic key performance indicators (KPIs).
   

  

 Proven experience with business and technical requirements analysis, elicitation, modeling, verification, and methodology development
   

  

 Demonstrated project management skills and project management software skills, including planning and organizing
   

  

 You will report toTeam Lead \-IT
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Our benefits package includes …
   

  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On\-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!


*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*

With over four decades of experience, D\&B supports clients throughout the entire building lifecycle, from feasibility and concept design through construction, commissioning, and ongoing asset management. * Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, including clear written and verbal communication and the ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

* Strong attention to detail, eagerness to learn, and ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment based in Chennai.
* Interest in vertical transportation, façade access, building design, or construction consultancy is highly beneficial.

title: Hardware Functional Safety (FuSa) Specialist
description:
**Enabling a software\-defined, electrified future.**
 Visteon is a technology company that develops and builds innovative digital cockpit and electrification products at the leading\-edge of the mobility revolution. Founded in 2000, Visteon brings decades of automotive intelligence combined with Silicon Valley speed to apply global insights that help transform the software\-defined vehicle of the future for many of the world’s largest OEMs. The company employs 10,000 employees in 18 countries around the globe. To know more about us click here .
   

  

**Mission of the Role** 
**:** 
 The Functional Safety Specialist is responsible for ensuring that automotive electronic systems comply with ISO 26262 and related safety standards. The role involves safety concept creation, hazard analysis, safety requirements engineering, technical safety architecture, verification planning, and supporting hardware/software teams through the full safety lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Functional Safety Lifecycle Management
* Lead and execute activities across the ISO 26262 V\-model safety lifecycle, from concept phase to SOP.
* Develop and maintain the Functional Safety Plan, timelines, and work products.
* Ensure processes are followed and all safety artifacts are created and reviewed.
* Safety Analysis \& Concept Development
* Perform Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (HARA) and derive ASIL levels.
* Develop Functional Safety Concept (FSC) and Technical Safety Concept (TSC).
* Define safety goals, safety mechanisms, and safety requirements (FSR/TSR).
* Requirements Engineering
* Write, review, and maintain functional and technical safety requirements.
* Ensure bi\-directional traceability between requirements, design, implementation, and validation.
* Support system, hardware, and software teams to interpret and implement safety requirements.
* Hardware \& Software Safety
* Collaborate with hardware architects to define safety mechanisms for MCU, PMIC, watchdog, self\-tests, power domains, fault handling, etc.
* Support software teams in designing safety\-compliant drivers, boot, diagnostics, and monitoring logic.
* Review MCU safety manuals, safety architecture, and vendor documentation (e.g., Infineon Traveo II, NXP, Renesas).
* Safety Analysis \& Verification
* Conduct and review FMEA, FTA, FMEDA, DFA, Dependent Failure Analysis.
* Calculate FIT rates, single\-point fault metrics, and latent fault metrics.
* Create safety validation plans and support unit/integration/system\-level testing.
* Audits, Assessments \& Compliance
* Prepare safety case documentation for customer and auditor reviews.
* Work with internal/external assessors (TÜV, Exida, OEM auditors).
* Support ASPICE, cybersecurity (ISO 21434\), and quality\-compliance alignment.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Provide training and guidance to development teams on ISO 26262 processes.
* Work directly with system architects, hardware designers, software teams, testing, quality, cybersecurity, and program management.
* Participate in design reviews and ensure safety considerations are incorporated early.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
**Technical Skills**
* Strong understanding of ISO 26262 Part 2–12 and full safety lifecycle.
* Expertise in safety analyses: FMEA, FTA, FMEDA, DFA.
* Understanding of safety architecture for MCUs, SoCs, and automotive ECUs.
* Experience with safety mechanisms: lockstep CPUs, watchdogs, ECC, BIST/MBIST, CRC, voltage monitoring, clock monitoring, safe states, etc.
* Experience with requirements management tools: DOORS, Polarion, Jama, etc.
* Working knowledge of embedded systems, microcontrollers, hardware design, and automotive software development.


**Domain Knowledge**
* Automotive electronics: clusters, body control, powertrain, ADAS, infotainment, or battery systems.
* Exposure to ASPICE, ISO 21434 (Cybersecurity), and OEM\-specific safety processes.
* Experience
* 5–15 years of experience in automotive embedded systems.
* Minimum 5\+ years in Functional Safety roles.
* Experience delivering at least one safety\-critical product to SOP.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Certified Functional Safety Engineer/Professional (TÜV, Exida).
* Experience with safety implementation on MCUs like Infineon Traveo II, NXP S32, Renesas R\-Car, TI Hercules.
* Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Embedded Systems, or related engineering field.
* Experience with model\-based development (MATLAB/Simulink).


**Visteon Culture:** 
 If you thrive in a fast\-paced, organizational culture that requires agility, adaptability, and a growth mindset from its employees to thrive and stay ahead of the curve Visteon is the place. We value high performance and a drive for results. Innovation, risk\-taking, and continuous learning help us keep up with the ever\-changing landscape of our industry and be Market leaders. At Visteon you can be more.

* Passion for learning and coaching others.
* Ability to adapt to evolving platform features and regulatory changes.
* Detail\-oriented, organized, and experienced in project coordination.

 New product innovations in line with Group, Technical meets calendar, Demos’s.

title: Technician - VAVE
description:
**Company Profile**
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)** 
 Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry\-leading climate\-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Summary:** 
 The Technician will support the VAVE team by performing product tear\-down activities, collecting and documenting engineering data, preparing analysis reports, and maintaining technical records. The role requires hands\-on disassembly of products, accurate measurement and documentation of components, and collaboration with engineering teams to identify cost reduction and product improvement opportunities.
   

  

**Tear Down Activities**
* Perform systematic tear\-down and disassembly of products, assemblies, and components.
* Identify, classify, and organize parts for further analysis.
* Record component details including material, dimensions, manufacturing process, and part functions.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of teardown components and samples.


**Data Collection \& Analysis Support**
* Collect engineering data from tear\-down activities, drawings, specifications, and BOMs.
* Measure components using standard measuring instruments.
* Capture photographs and maintain detailed records of findings.
* Create and maintain databases of product components, materials, and costs.
* Support benchmarking and competitive product analysis activities.


**Report Preparation**
* Prepare tear\-down reports, data sheets, comparison charts, and presentation materials.
* Document observations, findings, and recommendations in a structured format.
* Generate reports highlighting component details, cost opportunities, and design differences.


**Team Collaboration**
* Work closely with VAVE Engineers, Design Engineers.
* Support engineering reviews and project discussions with collected data and documentation.


**Quality \& Safety**
* Follow laboratory/workshop safety procedures.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and confidentiality of technical data.


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications**
 Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics Engineering or related discipline.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 MS Office proficiency, drawing/BOM interpretation, measurement tools knowledge, documentation and analytical skills.
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
 Experience in VAVE, cost reduction, benchmarking, reverse engineering, CAD and PLM systems.
   

  

**Primary Objective**
 Support the VAVE team through product tear\-down, detailed data collection, technical documentation, and report generation to enable cost optimization and product improvement.

**About The Role**
 As the Team Manager for Technical Writing at Epiroc, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the delivery of high\-quality technical documentation that supports the safe operation and maintenance of our advanced mining, earthmoving, and drilling equipment. Your leadership will be instrumental in driving the development of instruction manuals and standard operating procedures (SOPs) that are precise, user\-friendly, and aligned with product requirements.
   

  

 You will collaborate cross\-functionally with project offices, R\&D, and service operations teams to gather, refine, and incorporate critical product information. Using advanced Content Management Systems and Technical Information platforms, you will ensure the efficient publishing and timely communication of technical documents to our customers and stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the creation and maintenance of comprehensive technical manuals and SOPs for a broad range of equipment including drill rigs, loaders, and trucks, ensuring technical accuracy and compliance with engineering standards.
* Collaborate closely with internal teams such as R\&D, project offices, and field service to acquire and validate content for publication.
* Manage and optimize the use of content management systems and technology tools like Adobe InDesign, XMetaL, Oxygen, Teamcenter, and Schema ST4 to enable modular content creation and single\-sourcing for maximum reuse and consistency.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to innovate technical communication methods, reduce translation costs, simplify content complexity, and enhance overall documentation quality and customer experience.
* Regularly engage with customers to collect feedback on documentation usability and implement improvements that strengthen client relationships and satisfaction.
* Recruit, develop, and retain a skilled technical writing team by nurturing a motivated, collaborative, and high\-performance culture.
* Provide ongoing coaching, mentoring, and performance evaluations, fostering professional growth aligned with evolving business and technology trends.
* Define, implement, and refine internal standards, workflows, and best practices to enhance operational efficiency and deliverables quality.
* Monitor team performance through metrics and reporting tools, ensuring objectives related to quality, delivery timelines, and resource management are met consistently.
* Promote Epiroc’s core values including integrity, inclusivity, and open communication within your team and broader corporate community.


**Required Qualifications And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automobile Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Minimum of 12 years of industrial experience specifically within mining, earthmoving, drilling equipment, or off\-road vehicle sectors.
* Extensive experience in structured authoring, modular content development, and enterprise\-level Content Management Systems delivering single\-source publishing solutions.
* Proven expertise in technical documentation methodologies including topic\-based authoring, minimalism in communication, DITA standards, and XML authoring tools such as XMetaL or Oxygen.
* Familiarity with Simplified Technical English to ensure clarity and global usability of documentation.
* Strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign), Teamcenter, and Schema ST4 for document management and production.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills to translate complex technical and customer requirements into clear, actionable tasks.
* Demonstrated effective communication and leadership capabilities with experience managing multi\-disciplinary teams in dynamic, results\-driven environments.


**Desired Behaviors and Competencies**
* Highly enthusiastic and responsible with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to excel in a fast\-paced, pressure\-driven environment.
* Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to foster collaboration across diverse teams and stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and analytical skills combined with a goal\-oriented and self\-motivated mindset.
* Adaptable, open\-minded, and receptive to new ideas, technologies, and working methods.
* Committed to continuous learning and professional development for oneself and the team.


**Why Join Us?**
 This role offers a unique opportunity to take full ownership of the technical documentation lifecycle within a leading company in the mining industry. You will lead a talented team and be empowered to innovate documentation processes and technologies, contributing directly to product safety, usability, and customer satisfaction. Epiroc fosters an inclusive, values\-driven culture where integrity, collaboration, and respect are paramount. Additionally, this position provides substantial opportunities for professional growth and skill enhancement aligned with industry advancements.
   

  

**About Epiroc**
 Epiroc is a global leader in mining and infrastructure equipment, dedicated to sustainable productivity and innovation. Our commitment to safety, ethics, and diversity creates a dynamic workplace where employees thrive and contribute to impactful projects that shape the future of mining technologies.
   

  

 Join us and be part of a culture that values your unique talents and supports your career journey.

 The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.

title: Associate Engineer - Digital & Drw Mgmt
description:
**What’s The Role**
 Technical Asset Support (TAS) is a key enabler for the accelerated delivery of Shell’s Asset Management System and will help us to reach our ultimate potential in Downstream Manufacturing, Integrated Gas and Upstream. TAS provides high quality and cost\-competitive technical resources who are not physically present at site yet are an integral part of asset teams delivering value through end\-to\-end SEAM / AMS work processes.
   

  

 As an Associate Engineer \- Digital \& Drw Mgmt, you will support engineering document and drawing management in the energy industry by reviewing redline markups, updating and quality\-checking technical drawings and documents, and ensuring compliance with document control standards. It requires experience with AVEVA P\&ID, MicroStation, EDMS, and SharePoint, along with the ability to interpret P\&IDs, isometrics, and other engineering drawings, manage metadata, validate data quality, and support intelligent P\&ID conversion and maintenance activities.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Review red line markup (RLM) changes in technical drawings, collaborating with team members, incorporating revisions, and contributing to overall work quality. Work in EDMS (Doc Management tool).
* Proficient in interpreting and understanding corrections, redline markups, and updates across related engineering drawings.
* Proficient in AVEVA P\&ID as an end user with strong practical working experience.
* Ability to read, understand, and interpret P\&IDs, Isometrics, Plot Plans, and General Arrangement (GA) drawings.
* Strong knowledge of AVEVA P\&ID application, including object attributes, relationships, and validation checks.
* Generate and analyze engineering reports, line lists, equipment lists, valve lists, and other project deliverables from the AVEVA P\&ID database.
* Ability to identify, analyze, and resolve AVEVA P\&ID application issues related to drawing connectivity, database attributes, validation errors, and reporting inconsistencies.
* Experience in preparing engineering documentation, drawing evidence, and technical records to support Root Cause Analysis (Why\-Why Analysis) and incident investigations.
* Developed automated workflows and reports to enhance engineering productivity and data integrity.
* Experience working in critical assessment and quality review environments, ensuring high accuracy and compliance.
* Hands\-on experience in conversion projects from non\-intelligent (legacy) to intelligent P\&IDs, including data structuring and tagging.
* Ability to analyze, extract, and interpret reports generated from AVEVA P\&ID for quality control and data validation.
* Good understanding of engineering data consistency, tagging philosophy, and metadata management within P\&ID systems.
* Interpret and validate Process \& Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&IDs) based on process engineering principles, plant operations, and maintenance requirements.
* Identify discrepancies between P\&IDs, PFDs, Isometrics, Cause \& Effect diagrams, and other engineering documents.
* Perform engineering data validation to ensure compliance with asset tagging standards, drawing standards, and engineering best practices.
* Understand process flow, equipment functions, piping systems, control philosophy, and instrumentation represented in P\&IDs.
* Analyze the impact of proposed changes on equipment, piping systems, instrumentation, and associated engineering data.


**What You Bring**
* A graduate engineering degree with 3\+ years of relevant industry standard experience in combination of Process, mechanical, instrumentation \& electrical disciplines.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure during peak workloads and provide flexible support across related processes within team scope.
* Hands\-on experience with AVEVA P\&ID and MicroStation is mandatory.
* Performed data validation, consistency checks, and quality assurance of P\&ID deliverables.
* Support Team Leads with drawing\-related queries and technical support needs, including training site staff on software and request tools, and assisting with pilot tests and demonstrations.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to deliver analytical solutions are essential.
* Strong stakeholder management and time management skills are required.
* Candidates should demonstrate strong learning agility and a growth mindset.
* Excellent communication skills and a quick learner. Be a good team player. Ability to prioritize and ensure delivery of priorities for the area of responsibility. Flexible and adaptable to change, with a track record of demonstrating initiative, analytical capabilities and problem\-solving.
* Ability to apply engineering best practices, codes, and standards to identify issues, recommend improvements, and implement solutions.
* Excellent stakeholder management with business interface exposure
* Strong interpersonal leadership skills are critical due to the requirement for effective communication of complex issues across multiple offices and teams.
* Ability to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple projects and programs simultaneously.
* Ability to independently, resourcefully, and creatively research and implement new solutions.
* Ability to engage and effectively communicate at all levels inside and outside Shell and within different cultural settings.
* Strong interpersonal skills, ability to challenge and ability to build internal and external relationships based on trust and to integrate across multiple functions.
* Competitive applicants will have a proven track record of delivery in Asset and/or Project.
* While the hubs will remain the core locations for SEAM, we will continue to use a distributed working model. This means that our preference is to appoint the best candidate for the job on local terms working virtually from their base country.
* This role does not require global travel but may require flexibility in working hours to support collaboration across time zones, influence stakeholders, and drive business performance. Such flexibility will be considered with sensitivity to diverse family circumstances.


**What We Offer**
 You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
   

  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values\-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.
